tools.name: cron_add
tools.description: Create a scheduled cron job that runs on a recurring schedule. The job will execute the given prompt as an agent task.

schedule.description: Cron expression (6 fields: sec min hour day month weekday). Example: '0 0 9 * * *' for daily at 9am

prompt.description: The prompt/task to execute when the job fires

description.description: Optional description of what this job does

enabled.description: Whether the job is active (default: true)

tools.name: cron_delete
tools.description: Delete a cron job by ID.

job_id.description: The cron job ID to delete

tools.name: cron_list
tools.description: List all cron jobs for the current user.

tools.name: cron_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable a cron job.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

tools.name: cron_run
tools.description: Manually trigger a cron job to run immediately, regardless of its schedule.

job_id.description: The cron job ID to run now
